## Ordering food
From choosing a restaurant to the order confirmed.

1. Home [grid]: Sees nearby restaurants, taps one. → 2
   shot: screenshots/1-1-home.png
2. Menu [list]: Adds dishes to the basket, taps "Checkout". → 3
   shot: screenshots/1-2-menu.png
3. Pay [form]: Enters the card, taps "Pay now". → 4
   shot: screenshots/1-3-pay.png
   ! Card refused: Sees "Payment failed", taps "Try again". → 3
4. Confirmed [done]: Sees the order number and the delivery time.
   shot: screenshots/1-4-confirmed.png
